selected_gaps.gap: Under a limited initial budget, no retrieved frontier establishes that the observed low-fidelity score preserves the sign and ordering of paper interventions by the performance improvement they later produce on independently specified user tasks; a probe can therefore support the wrong go/no-go decision even when it is internally faithful.
selected_gaps.selection_rationale: This remains the most load-bearing method gap, but the deliverable is narrowed to direct task-specific evidence for one source-grounded load-bearing claim rather than a prediction of whole-paper adoption utility. Decompose and delegate closes it by compiling that claim into machine-checkable obligations and routing every obligation to an executable witness, avoiding learning-curve prediction, causal transport, and multi-fidelity allocation.

selected_gaps.gap: No retrieved frontier estimates net benefit after execution cost, adaptation effort, and regressions on task dimensions outside the paper's headline metric are deducted from gross performance gain.
selected_gaps.selection_rationale: Under a sequential_pipeline thread, the obligation compiler's executable graph becomes the input to matched deletion and intervention-off controls, so the local claim effect is not confounded with non-load-bearing reproduction machinery. Controlled diagnostic design closes this gap by holding the task, environment, scorer, and retained obligations fixed while directly measuring task-score delta, guardrail regressions, execution cost, and adaptation effort.

deliverable_coverage: method - the anchor gap's decompose_and_delegate pattern ships a runnable source-anchored obligation compiler and executable witness-minimization loop.

deferred_gaps.gap: No retrieved paper tests whether tasks derived from the paper or skill, or selected by a fixed reproduction benchmark, are representative enough of the user's target-task distribution to support an adoption decision.
deferred_gaps.reason: A fixed user-task contract prevents artifact-conditioned task generation but does not establish distributional representativeness; that requires a separate task-sampling study.

deferred_gaps.gap: No retrieved frontier quantifies decision calibration across paper families, user tasks, agent models, environments, and probe budgets, including false-adoption and false-rejection rates.
deferred_gaps.reason: Cross-family calibration is out of scope because this candidate produces a direct per-task claim witness and makes no cross-paper utility prediction or ranking.
